config.intervention: Three arms: BCE+uniform KL control; Gaussian phone-logit policy; nonempty Bernoulli phone-subset policy with frozen original fusion scorer. Both RL arms use actual empirical EER and REINFORCE, without BCE or soft-EER. Acoustic encoder remains frozen. Reset AdamW; disable network dropout in every arm.
config.pairs: Replay source schedule rows 56000:64000 in groups of 16: 512 queries and 1024 positive/negative trials per update, 500 updates. Four independent policy rollouts reuse each batch. Preserve original common availability and five-vowel eligibility gate. Policies receive no label, corpus or speaker identifier.
config.reward: Negative empirical interpolated EER per training corpus present in each batch. Leave-one-out baseline across four independent rollouts within corpus. Mean over rollout/corpus of advantage times SUM of trial action log probabilities; batch EER is not a per-trial reward. Labels and corpus are used only by reward computation. KL to starting policy has coefficient 0.01.
config.weight_policy: Independent Normal phone logits, mean from existing Transformer; fixed per-seed sigma is median top-two logit gap on the first training replay batch, clipped to [1,10]. Mask unavailable dimensions; softmax sampled logits yields weights. Deterministic inference uses original mean-logit softmax. No reward-based sigma tuning.
config.subset_policy: Clone pretrained Transformer backbone; zero-initialize new scalar gate head. Bernoulli probabilities clipped through logits [-4,4], conditioned on a nonempty available subset with exact normalized log probability and KL. Frozen original Transformer reruns attention using selected subset. Deterministic p>=0.5, falling back to highest available probability when empty. Initially includes all available phones. No size penalty.
config.selection: Real normal-sentence validation EER every 100 updates including zero; earliest minimum equal-corpus JVS/CV/JTube mean. Report selected and fixed-final checkpoints. Freeze every model and validation FAR1% threshold before new test inference.
config.limits: Three acoustic seeds and one policy RNG seed, one preset budget/exploration/learning-rate setting. Previously observed test speakers. Stochastic batch reward differs from deterministic full-corpus validation/test EER. Subset arm adds a policy network and retains a frozen scorer; arms are not identical-capacity architectures. Equal pair exposure does not mean equal compute. No standard-model replacement.

bootstrap.method: Paired query/claim speaker bootstrap, shared draws across seeds and variants, independent corpora. Conditional on fixed models; excludes training/selection uncertainty.
